Pine API uses MariaDB for durable application records. Schema changes are reviewed by the service owner. A separate non-production environment is available for testing migrations. The database dashboard tracks connection pressure and the aggregate number of long-running queries.

Pine API has a 7 minute production canary observation window. The release owner checks errors and saturation before increasing traffic. The central status page only displays incidents that the response team has reviewed. Engineers keep the previous deployment available until the monitoring decision is recorded.

The required Pine API merge check is pine-ci. The team asks reviewers to include the status link when reopening a change. Maintainers inspect the queue on the project dashboard. A project-specific webhook forwards validation events to the release owner during working hours.
